description: Close one tab or a list of them — how you tidy up the isolated logins when a matrix run is finished. Returns which ids closed and which were already gone. Requires the one-time “Agent control” confirmation in the panel; without it the extension answers consent-required and does nothing.

tabIds.description: Several tabs to close, e.g. every isolated login from qa_tabs

name: qa_close_tab
title: Close tabs
